title: Ambidextrous global spectra and tempered cohomology
summary: We introduce generalizations of global equivariant spectra which encode globally equivariant cohomology theories equipped with additional transfers, such as the deflation maps present in equivariant topological $K$-theory. We call these $\mathcal{Q}$-ambidextrous global spectra, where $\mathcal{Q}$ is a parameter encoding which additional transfers one allows.
